name: Retroactive
description: Drops that reward past on-chain activity — usually announced after a snapshot. The highest-EV category historically.

name: Testnet
description: Active incentivized testnets where on-chain tasks accrue points convertible to a future token.

name: Points
description: Live points programs (Eigen, Ether.fi, Renzo, Pendle YT etc.) where points are expected to convert to tokens.

name: Holder
description: Hold-to-earn drops: holders of a specific NFT or token at snapshot qualify automatically.

name: Task-based
description: Galxe-style quest campaigns: complete on-chain or social tasks for whitelist or guaranteed allocation.

name: Exchange
description: Centralized exchange Launchpool / Megadrop / HODLer style drops (Binance, Bybit, OKX, MEXC).

name: Telegram
description: TON-native tap-to-earn and Telegram mini-app airdrops.
